newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ may alter policy before tax hike check - paper.
newsitem.headline: BOJ may alter policy before tax hike check - paper.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) may alter its monetary policy before assessing the possible economic impact of a planned rise in the consumption tax in April, a senior BOJ official was quoted as saying by the Nikkei Financial Daily on Thursday.
The official, who is in charge of policy-making at the central bank, said: "The economy is stronger than we anticipated."
"It is possible that (the BOJ) may decide to alter monetary policy before examining the impact from a planned consumption tax increase."
The senior BOJ official added; "I wonder why the market assessment (of the economy) has been so weak."
The newspaper is widely read by traders and financial institutions.

The official's remarks, signalling a possible early rise in Japanese interest rates, was one factor behind the dollar's steep slide against the yen in early Tokyo trading on Thursday, currency traders said.
